titleStmt.title: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary
A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible, with their Renderings in the King James Version
titleStmt.author: James Strong

availability.licence: Public domain. James Strong's dictionary (1890) is in the public domain, and so is Open Scriptures' edition ("Public Domain"). Converted to TEI by Bible Nav, with the corrections listed below.

sourceDesc.bibl: Open Scriptures, Strong's Hebrew Dictionary in OSIS, edited 2008-2010 by David Troidl and David Instone-Brewer from several public-domain sources and the 1890 original: https://github.com/openscriptures/strongs/blob/0acd2f251c2d35ff8db2dece4e0593979d3ac223/hebrew/StrongHebrewG.xml (commit 0acd2f251c2d35ff8db2dece4e0593979d3ac223, 2021-07-15), file SHA-256 1f9659ea208f4c498843a0280dacb1448627c33ca77712642d8705793ab66061.
James Strong, A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Hebrew Bible, in The Exhaustive Concordance of the Bible (New York: Hunt & Eaton, 1890).

encodingDesc.p: Each entry is one of Strong's numbered entries; its xml:id is the Strong's number (H1 to H8674). The headword (orth) is Open Scriptures' pointed lemma, followed by Strong's transliteration and pronunciation. etym holds Strong's derivation, def his definition, and the note of type kjvRenderings his list of renderings in the King James Version. A ref links to another entry by number; mentioned is a Hebrew word with no number, such as an alternative spelling. Both carry Strong's transliteration (bn:translit) and pronunciation (bn:pron) where the source gives them. Notes of type sourceCorrection are Open Scriptures' own notes on what they corrected. Headwords marked x-pn (proper names, with no language) in the source are tagged hbo here.

Left out from the source, as not part of Strong's dictionary or not free to copy: outlines (list): 8674; TWOT numbers (gloss): 6070; Greek equivalents (foreign): 3686; part-of-speech codes (morph): 8674.
